name: reverse-grip-one-arm-standing-overhead-cable-tricep-extension.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the reverse grip one-arm overhead tricep extension by attaching a single grip handle to the low pulley cable and selecting the weight you want to use on the stack.
2. Grasp the handle with your left hand, raise your left arm above your head, and turn away from the machine.
3. Your palm should be facing backward, towards the cable machine. This is the starting position for the exercise.
4. Keeping your body fixed and bending at the elbow only, slowly lower the weight back behind your body.
5. Pause, and then raise the weight, squeezing the tricep at the top of the movement.
6. Do not lock your elbow out, and then lower weight and repeat.
7. Repeat reps for your right arm.
